title: The Clean Extraction
author: Wendell Okafor
blurb: Ines Ravensworth, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
